text:
Mira Patel: dropping a fresh mock for the console create form. idea: use a tiny dashed-outline dot after labels as the required marker (low emphasis) + a keyboard-only reveal that shows the word 'Required' when tab-focused. figma: https://figma.redwood/company/forms-req-dash

Daniel Park: visually it's subtle and tidy. concern: when scanning many fields, will users miss the marker? keyboard-only reveal helps, but touch users won't see hover states.

Priya Desai: agree about touch. proposal: show the dashed dot by default on desktop, always show a low-contrast "Req" label on small screens. make the keyboard reveal explicit by inserting a visually-hidden helper that becomes visible on focus. SRs should still get aria-required.

Alex Morgan: implementation notes: set aria-required="true" on required inputs. Link inline errors with aria-describedby to the error element. For inline validation timing: validate on blur for non-empty inputs; if empty, defer error until submit to avoid noisy feedback while typing. For cross-field errors, show a compact summary at the top with anchor links that focus the field (tabindex=-1) and bring it into view.

Kevin Liu: accessibility checklist: role=alert for inline error text when it appears so screen readers announce it. For summary at top, ensure it has an accessible heading and the links focus the target field using element.focus(); add tabindex=-1 on the target to make focusable. Avoid duplicate announcements: pick one primary announcement (usually inline) and keep the summary passive unless user navigates it. For the keyboard-only reveal, ensure the visible helper is not duplicated via aria-labels.

Mira Patel: on destructive actions: propose typed-confirm (type full resource name) for org-level and long-lived things. For row-level or bulk deletes, use checkbox + modal with large danger CTA. Always add an undo snackbar for reversable deletes (7s). Copy: use contextual text, e.g., "Type the workspace name 'acme-prod' to confirm deletion."

Daniel Park: +1. typed-confirm should be used sparingly. Also: show an inline validation on typed-confirm (exact match) and mark error with role=alert. For checkbox flows, require an explicit click on the danger CTA, not just Enter, to reduce accidental keyboard confirmations.

Priya Desai: copy tweaks: prefer active copy "This action is permanent and will delete all project data." then the typed-confirm line. For the small-screen 'Req' label, use full "Required" in the accessible name so SR users hear the word, not abbreviation.

Alex Morgan: analytics ask: A/B dashed-dot vs asterisk vs explicit 'Req' badge for new orgs. Track empty-submit rate, help-center hits for "missing required" and time-to-complete. Also instrument typed-confirm rate and undo usage.

Kevin Liu: modal accessibility reminders: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trap inside, and restore focus to the triggering control on close. Announce the modal title and instructions via accessible name, and use aria-live polite for helper updates.

Mira Patel: action items:
- design: add keyboard-only reveal and mobile fallback for required marker (Priya + Mira)
- eng: wire aria-required, aria-describedby, role=alert for inline errors, and implement anchor focus behavior (Alex + Kevin)
- analytics: spec A/B and metrics (Alex/Daniel)
- PM: doc typed-confirm thresholds + undo policy (Mira)

design-bot: reminder: put this on Thu design review agenda and tag accessibility review. :spiral_calendar:

Daniel Park: will add to the agenda and mark for 15 min slot.

Mira Patel: thanks all, I'll post updated frames (desktop + mobile) by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:
